read_config_parse_ini: parse an INI config file's lines into a dictionary supporting duplicate keys
write_config_output_ini: write a config dictionary back to an INI file format with sections
inplace_edit_modify_config: read a config file, modify it in a context manager, and write changes back
read_config_duplicate_keys: parse INI lines where the same key appears multiple times under one section
review_config_parser: review the config parser module that handles INI files with duplicate key support
